```{r}
rand_filtered<-rand%>%
  select(hhidpn,racohbyr)
```



```{r}
#convert values from 5 and 1 to 0 and 1 
binary_cols <- names(final_data_rand_cses)[
  sapply(final_data_rand_cses, function(x) {
    all(na.omit(unique(x)) %in% c(1, 5))
  })
]

```



```{r}
final_data_rand_cses <- final_data_rand_cses %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(binary_cols), ~ case_when(
    .x == 5 ~ 0,
    .x == 1 ~ 1,
    TRUE ~ NA_real_
  )))
```






```{r}
suffix_replace <- c(
  "037a" = "_child_died",
  "037b" = "_major_disaster",
  "037c" = "_fire_weapon",
  "037d" = "_sp_drugs",
  "037e" = "_physical_attack",
  "037f" = "_illness",
  "037g" = "_life_threatening"
)


for (pattern in names(suffix_replace)) {
  cols_to_rename <- grep(pattern, names(final_data_rand_cses), value = TRUE)
  if (length(cols_to_rename) > 0) {
    new_names <- gsub(pattern, suffix_replace[pattern], cols_to_rename)
    names(final_data_rand_cses)[names(final_data_rand_cses) %in% cols_to_rename] <- new_names
  }
}
```


```{r}
colnames(final_data_rand_cses)
```



```{r}
#create new variable: any_ACE 
childhood_cols <- c("police", "parent_drugs", "parent_abuse", "orphanage", 
              "fosterhome", "parent_divorce", "parent_died")


final_data_rand_cses$any_ACE <- ifelse(
  rowSums(final_data_rand_cses[, childhood_cols], na.rm = TRUE) > 0, 
  1, 
  0
)

final_data_rand_cses$any_ACE=factor(
  final_data_rand_cses$any_ACE, levels = c(0,1), labels = c("No","Yes"))
```



```{r}
#create new variable: any_trauma
mlb_nlb_cols <- grep("^(mlb|nlb)", names(final_data_rand_cses), value = TRUE)


final_data_rand_cses$any_trauma <- ifelse(
  rowSums(final_data_rand_cses[, mlb_nlb_cols], na.rm = TRUE) > 0,
  1,
  0
)


final_data_rand_cses$any_trauma=factor(
  final_data_rand_cses$any_trauma, levels = c(0,1), labels = c("No","Yes"))
```

# figure 2
```{r}
figure3_data <- read_csv("D:/OneDrive - University of Southern California/R00/Manuscripts/HRS/Stress sensitization/Data/figure 3.csv")
```




```{r}
figure3_data <- figure3_data %>%
  mutate(
    item = recode(
      item,
      "Sp drugs" = "Spouse, partner, or child was addicted to drugs or alcohol",
      "Physical attack" = "Victim of serious physical attack or assault",
      "Major disaster" = "Experienced a major disaster",
      "Life threatening" = "Spouse or child had life-threatening illness or accident",
      "Illness" = "Experienced life-threatening illness or accident",
      "Fire weapon" = "Fired or been fired upon in a combat",
      "Child died" = "Experienced death of a child"
    )
  )

```



```{r}
figure3_data <- figure3_data %>%
  mutate(effect = factor(effect, levels = c("main", "time", "interaction")))

figure3_data <- figure3_data %>%
  mutate(effect = recode(effect,
    "main" = "Main effect",
    "time" = "Time effect",
    "interaction" = "Interaction effect"
  ))


figure3_data <- figure3_data %>%
  mutate(
    model = factor(
      model,
      levels = c(
        "Overall",
        "No childhood adversity",
        "Experienced childhood adversity"
        )
    ),

    item = factor(
      item,
      levels = c(
        "Experienced death of a child",
        "Experienced a major disaster",
        "Fired or been fired upon in a combat",
        "Spouse, partner, or child was addicted to drugs or alcohol",
        "Victim of serious physical attack or assault",
        "Experienced life-threatening illness or accident",
        "Spouse or child had life-threatening illness or accident"
      )
    )
  )

figure3_data <- figure3_data %>%
  mutate(item = fct_rev(item))
```



```{r}

p<-ggplot(figure3_data,
       aes(x = item, y = estimate, color = model)) +
  
  geom_pointrange(
    aes(ymin = LCI, ymax = UCI),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.6),
    shape = 16,
    size = 0.2
  ) +
  
  coord_flip() +

  facet_grid(. ~ effect, switch = "y") +

  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    strip.placement = "outside",
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    
    axis.title.y = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 11),
    
    panel.spacing = unit(2, "lines"),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  ) +
  
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Estimate (95% CI)",
    color = "Model"
  )+

  scale_color_manual(
  breaks = c(
    "Experienced childhood adversity",
    "No childhood adversity",
    "Overall"
  ),
  values = c(
    "Overall" = "#1B9E77",
    "No childhood adversity" = "#D95F02",
    "Experienced childhood adversity" = "#7570B3"
  )
)



p
```
